integrity: The all-parameter integral theorem has a self-contained proof; the finite checker provides nonexhaustive-in-parameter mod-two corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Top integral homology and an abstract sphere-wedge homotopy retract only; lower homology, full homotopy type, and equivariance remain undetermined. Scientific comparisons may miss unindexed equivalent work.
title: Source–sink feedback edges split off Hamiltonian-path spheres in multipath complexes
